openclaw-enterprise 2.0.3

- 新增英文技能文档（SKILL_EN.md）
- 完善README.md和技能说明，提升快速上手指引和实际用例细节
- SKILL.md全面结构优化，突出核心功能、20个专业Agent清单、安全声明与常见场景
- 版本号更新至2.0.3，metadata与package.json等配置同步
- 优化多处说明文本，增强用户友好性
完善数据处理边界说明，增强安全声明透明度；统一版本元数据为2.0.1
触发词扩展至15个场景词；Summary重写为用户痛点导向；新增5个Use Cases用例章节；添加安全前置声明；添加Related Skills互链
Brand update
Level 2 upgrade: scripts added, compute logic + JSON output

openclaw-enterprise v1.2.6

- Updated skill version to 1.2.6 in configuration and documentation.
- Refreshed documentation files for clarity and accuracy.
- Minor adjustments to YAML configurations and templates.
- No breaking changes to core functionality.

**No functional changes detected for openclaw-enterprise 1.2.5.**

- Version bump to 1.2.5 with no file or documentation changes.
- All features, configuration, and documentation remain as in version 1.2.4.

**Summary:**  
This release focuses on enhanced workflow planning, updated security/privacy frameworks, and improved agent/API configuration options.

- Refined the system focus from generic workflow automation to advanced workflow planning and decision support.
- Expanded and clarified team structures, agent capabilities, and workflow planning use cases in documentation.
- Overhauled security and privacy section: added details on data storage, permission boundaries, API key management, and operational safeguards.
- Updated API integration: Anthropic API is now optional and enhances advanced reasoning when configured.
- Adjusted environment requirements (Anthropic API no longer required by default).
- Various terminology and trigger keyword updates for improved clarity and alignment with planning/consulting scenarios.
Fix placeholder API keys in README
Fixed install instructions: removed npm, use CLI only

**Summary:** Major upgrade streamlining architecture, adding multi-agent extensibility, and improving documentation and setup.

- Overhauled documentation with new files: quick start guides, security, pricing, publishing, and workflow examples.
- Simplified and expanded pricing plans; added free, basic, team, enterprise, and custom tiers.
- Switched default execution model to 16 specialized agents coordinated by a central "Chief of Staff" agent.
- Enhanced setup instructions (requirements, environment, install scripts, examples) for faster onboarding.
- Removed outdated templates, scripts, and references for leaner repo and easier maintenance.
- RESTful API specifications and architecture diagrams added for easier integration.
重新发布，等待安全审核
修复安全问题：添加完整凭证声明、第三方域名显式声明

openclaw-enterprise v1.0.6

- Added new script: scripts/industrial_agents.py
- Updated package.json with latest changes
- Enhanced support for industrial agent workflows through new script addition

- Added comprehensive SKILL.md detailing system features, architecture, deployment, APIs, pricing, and agent roles.
- Now includes clear multi-agent team structure, key collaboration workflows, and use-case triggers in both Chinese and English.
- Provides precise installation and deployment instructions for SaaS and private options.
- Outlines verification checklist and common rationalizations for reliable operation.
- Updated metadata with API/environment/binary requirements and detailed pricing tiers.

**Changelog for openclaw-enterprise v1.0.4**

- Introduced a progressive loading structure in SKILL.md to optimize resource and instruction delivery.
- Enhanced SKILL.md with improved, English-first descriptions and explicit trigger guidance for system use cases.
- Added new "Common Rationalizations" and "Verification" sections in documentation to clarify system scope and expected outcomes.
- Updated versioning and metadata to 1.0.4; adjusted author and tags display for consistency.
- Added new release note file: 推广效果/重发布日志_20260424.md.
License update: Unified to MIT-0. No functional changes.

- Added homepage and license information to documentation
- Expanded metadata to include API requirements, environment variables, and authentication details
- Listed supported external APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Enterprise APIs) and their purposes
- Specified required environment variables (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) and binaries (python3, pip, curl) in metadata
- No functional changes to the system described, but documentation is now more detailed and explicit for setup and API usage

**OpenClaw Enterprise v1.0.0 - 全新简化与专注企业AI团队版本**

- 精简定位为“1幕僚长+20专业Agent”企业运营AI系统，突出团队替代与协作能力
- 彻底重构&精简文档，移除大量说明、原快速入门、API/架构/细节和示例，简介聚焦应用价值与团队架构
- 全面优化定价体系，主打Basic/Professional/Enterprise三档，明晰并行数与功能覆盖
- 技术栈与要求简明化：仅需python3、pip、httpx等常规组件，去除复杂安装指令
- 明确卸载了旧API接口、文件组织和快速上手脚本，仅提供SaaS和私有化部署指导
- 关键词路由与职业Agent清单高度可读，便于企业用户理解与选型

openclaw-enterprise 1.2.0

- 发布企业级多Agent协作系统，基于 LangChain + LangGraph 构建
- 提供16种专业执行Agent，支持复杂任务智能分解与并行处理
- 新增 Designer Agent，集成 Coze CLI 支持图片生成与在线交付
- 完善企业级特性：记忆系统、权限控制、成本追踪、审计日志
- 提供多档定价方案（免费至定制），满足不同企业需求
- 丰富快速上手指南与详细 API 文档
